+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+AWS_KMS_DECRYPT_URL = "https://kms.{region}.amazonaws.com/"
+
+
+def _signing_headers(target: str, payload: str, region: str, service: str = "kms") -> Dict[str, str]:
+    raise NotImplementedError("AWS SigV4 signing is required for live requests")
+
+
+def decrypt_payload(ciphertext_b64: str, region: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    region = region or os.environ.get("AWS_REGION") or os.environ.get("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION")
+    if not region:
+        raise ValueError("AWS region must be provided via region or AWS_REGION/AWS_DEFAULT_REGION")
+
+    endpoint = AWS_KMS_DECRYPT_URL.format(region=region)
+    body = {
+        "CiphertextBlob": ciphertext_b64,
+    }
+
+    headers = {
+        "content-type": "application/x-amz-json-1.1",
+        "x-amz-target": "TrentService.Decrypt",
+    }
+    headers.update(_signing_headers("TrentService.Decrypt", json.dumps(body), region))
+
+    response = requests.post(endpoint, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(body), timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data: Dict[str, Any] = response.json()
+    plaintext = data.get("Plaintext")
+    if not plaintext:
+        raise ValueError("AWS KMS response did not include Plaintext")
+    if isinstance(plaintext, str):
+        return base64.b64decode(plaintext).decode("utf-8")
+    return base64.b64decode(plaintext).decode("utf-8")

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: encrypt_payload.py
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import boto3
+
+
+def encrypt_payload(plaintext: str, key_id: Optional[str] = None, region_name: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    kms = boto3.client("kms", region_name=region_name or os.getenv("AWS_REGION") or os.getenv("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION"))
+    response = kms.encrypt(KeyId=key_id or os.environ["AWS_KMS_KEY_ID"], Plaintext=plaintext.encode("utf-8"))
+    ciphertext_blob = response["CiphertextBlob"]
+    return {
+        "provider": "aws_kms",
+        "key_id": key_id or os.environ["AWS_KMS_KEY_ID"],
+        "ciphertext_blob_b64": base64.b64encode(ciphertext_blob).decode("ascii"),
+        "encryption_algorithm": response.get("EncryptionAlgorithm"),
+        "arn": response.get("KeyId"),
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import argparse
+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Encrypt a plaintext payload with AWS KMS.")
+    parser.add_argument("plaintext")
+    parser.add_argument("--key-id", dest="key_id")
+    parser.add_argument("--region", dest="region_name")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(encrypt_payload(args.plaintext, args.key_id, args.region_name)))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
